name: Handheld Offer
description: A hand extends the product toward camera, offering it directly to the viewer — the intimate, human register of a real person sharing something they love, not a stand-alone hero shot.
subject: either
prompt: a hand and forearm extending the product toward the camera at a natural offering angle, the hand and wrist in soft focus at the edge of frame while the product itself stays tack-sharp and centered, soft window-adjacent light falling naturally across the skin and product with true warm falloff and no artificial studio rig visible, a softly blurred neutral indoor background with no discernible props or furniture, genuine skin texture on the hand with no over-smoothing, no face in frame, no second person, natural unposed finger placement that doesn't obscure the product's label or branding, intimate hand-to-camera commercial warmth
